title: PlayMax ⚡ High-Speed Mobile Update Available (v1.5.1)
message: Naya lag-free update aa gaya hai! Cricket channels stutter fix, 1-tap Fullscreen & Aspect Ratio controls, aur super smooth fast UI ke liye abhi update karein.
releaseNotes: 🚀 Zero-Lag Playback: Cricket channels below Star Sports now play 100% smooth without stutter
⤢ Aspect Ratio Toggle: New diagonal button to switch 16:9 Fit, Cover Zoom, and Stretch modes
⛶ Dedicated Fullscreen: Instant 1-tap landscape fullscreen mode
❚❚ Center Controls: Sleek circular Play/Pause button matching OTT reference UI
⚡ App-wide Performance: Eliminated list lag, timer stalls, and memory overhead
🛡️ 100% Safe & Clean: Zero virus, zero grabber, fully hardened build
